review_method: Full source bodies and reachable helpers reviewed; independent semantic contracts remain the design anchor. Many-to-many replacement records preserve unique regressions without retaining legacy organization or private performance snapshots.

source_reviews.rationale: CSV records are independently authored and consumed by Mojo grammar/value references, including quoted empty versus null, CR/LF, custom quote/delimiter, buffer boundaries, integer width limits, Float32 rounding, categorical values, strict/lossy UTF8 including unprojected text, default 100-row inference boundary, overrides, disabled quotes, projection/limits/skips, malformed rows and options. Native builder ownership/reuse and late error/early-stop cleanup have named witnesses. Old random seeds and exact parser buffer choices are inputs rather than promised behavior. Two verified trailing-EOF/categorical writer defects remain strict expected failures; no deletion treats them as working.

Complete typed rows/schema/null validity and API error contracts replace string-formatted snapshots as general equality oracles. Display alone retains literal shape/dtype/escaping/codepoint/clipping assertions. Inspection covers bounds, selectors, zero-column heights, describe logical types and nonfinite policy; sampling checks complete row association, replacement/uniqueness/order/seed plus broad deterministic distribution. Structural equality is separately tested as the public operation, with hidden nested payload defect explicitly expected.

Opaque names include empty, delimiter/escaped ambiguity, comma, quote/backslash, newline and Unicode. Independent complete-cell expectations cover selector prefixes, Struct fields, partition windows, grouping and differently encoded shared lazy name lists. Names remain data, not internal key delimiters.

Initialized/uninitialized advised allocations are checked across zero, page and huge-page boundaries after every slot is written. Unaligned advice retains every surrounding byte. No speed or OS huge-page success is asserted: advice is a performance option, initialized values and ownership are contracts.

Actual typed direct, SIMD column-statistics, indexed and declined-specialization entry points are compared with independent Int128/scaled numeric references across every numeric width, groups/empty groups, intervals, masks, offsets and chunks. Final overflow is distinct from partial overflow. SIMD widening, shifted SUM range and UInt64 moment defects remain precise strict failures; comparing two production paths is never the only oracle.

Actual fused width1/4/8 entry points, repeated sources, interior/misaligned chunk windows, leaf bitmap eligibility and public chunk reassembly boundary are checked against scalar arithmetic and full typed validity. Internal node layout text is not a public expectation.

Independent atomic jobs verify accepted job execution/results, exact destruction, changing claims/rounds, nested budget/crew, producer unwind/cancellation/capacity, first error then retry, destructor drain and oversubscribed parked workers. Environment scopes preserve absent versus empty as well as nonempty values. Exact morsel count/alignment and spin heuristic snapshots are intentionally retired performance tuning; observable work completeness, ordering, budgets and cleanup remain checked.

Dispatch-sized datasets explicitly establish actual worker eligibility, independently compute all cells/statistics, preserve complete ordered rows through casts, predicates, stateful groups/joins and parallel assembly, and verify earliest error/retry. Merely setting an un-terminated environment buffer or comparing one dataframe executor against another is replaced. Misaligned streamed group validity is a strict failure. Uncontrolled parallel positional global-reduction ordering is recorded as a known coverage limitation, not a flaky XFAIL.

Portable instrumented providers prove source/model identity, options, complete cells, preflight/no-call refusal, backend absence/fallback/reason, forced native rejection and errors. Native Metal has separate capability-gated witnesses and no Linux skip is counted as successful device execution.

Lazy rewrites compare independently modeled full rows with execution fixed and optimization varied, separately from batch/worker variation. Dependencies, replacement/filter/slice and cardinality barriers, group order/nulls, reused branches, exploded/Struct hidden fields, cross pairs, independently transformed union branches and schema errors are explicit. Existing object equality/explain whitespace and private scheduling heuristics do not anchor the new organization.

Positive timer values, exact formatting and arbitrary historic sample positions are not correctness requirements.

Old driver generation/group sizing/binary reuse are retired with their runner. Mojo runner tests prove exact discovery and selection, compiler/runtime failure propagation, required diagnostic/exit matching and XPASS rejection, capability skips, isolated crashes, current source provenance and fresh output isolation. Explicit fake-compiler tests preserve orchestration failures; obsolete TEST_PARQUET_BINARY reuse is not a supported fresh-suite interface. Actual old suite passed during transition before retirement.

source_reviews.body_review: Root reviewed actual hash aggregation entrypoints and the legacy test in conjunction with nested agent full-body review.
source_reviews.rationale: Direct hash_agg_eligible and hash_aggregate calls now compare independent complete Int128/scaledFloat64 states, null keys/values and first representatives at actual parallel dispatch size with workers1/2/4. Eligibility declines unsupported/computed shapes. Per-partition internal ordering is intentionally not promised; every representative/group and full typed cells are checked. Focused case and consolidated99kernel checks passed.

known_coverage_limits.obligation: Multiworker streamed global FIRST/LAST/ARG_MIN/ARG_MAX preserve logical source order
known_coverage_limits.finding: Manual public multiworker probe produced scheduling-dependent positional results. Existing deterministic positional checks use one worker; multiworker mergeable statistics and row-pipeline order remain checked.
known_coverage_limits.disposition: Implementation defect requires separate deterministic scheduling regression and production fix. No flaky expected failure or copied production merge loop is included.
